subject.title: skill safe-encryption-skill: Spec Prohibits File Output But CLI Tool's Standard Interface Is File Output

question: Should ClawHub leave version 0.1.0 public while requesting publisher correction, or apply a moderation hold or exact-version revocation until it is corrected?
rationale: ClawHub cannot rewrite publisher-owned skill text, and deciding whether ambiguous encryption guidance crosses the marketplace distribution threshold requires human security-policy judgment.

options.title: Request publisher correction
options.body: Keep the listing available while asking the publisher to distinguish intentional final ciphertext output from prohibited temporary artifacts.

options.title: Hold the listing
options.body: Temporarily hide the skill while the publisher prepares and publishes corrected instructions.

options.title: Revoke version 0.1.0
options.body: Permanently revoke the affected version if its current guidance is judged materially unsafe to distribute.

recommendation.title: Request publisher correction
recommendation.body: Keep the listing available while asking the publisher to distinguish intentional final ciphertext output from prohibited temporary artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent exact-version revocation and security-scan work most directly matches the decision and available remedies.
